summary: For A_m=[1] direct_sum J_m/m direct_sum (-J_m/m), the global third exterior-volume mass is exactly 1, but any active original-coordinate set S of fixed size k retains at most (k-1)^4/(16m^4); retaining a fixed positive fraction forces |S| linear in m. The best physical principal-triple determinant is m^-2, so arbitrarily fine mass-linear law localization followed by fragment-dependent use of the completed principal-triple determinant certificate still has a divergent m^(2/3) certificate cost. This refutes bounded-active-set matrix localization as a universal bridge, not QFORM.
